info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Void Authorization API
info.description: The Void Authorization API allows businesses to reverse or cancel previously processed authorizations based on a specific authorization ID. This endpoint is particularly useful for payment processing services, enabling merchants to manage their transactions effectively. Typical consumers include application developers and payment platform providers who need to ensure that incorrect or unnecessary authorizations can be voided in a timely manner. This operation aids in maintaining accurate financial records and enhancing customer service by preventing unwanted charges.

post.summary: Void an authorization by its ID.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to void an existing authorization using its unique identifier. This operation is crucial for managing and correcting transactions when necessary.
